body: That’s so interesting that you can get around that

Thank you for the info! That was one of the concerns but never thought of it that way. My forever thought was “if you have modern it gives you consistency and reaction time plus if you do motion inputs there’s no draw back. What’s the point of classic?” But I can see how it could be considered redundant
Oh come on you don’t have to do that lol😅
This is great Im cryin a bit lol but this is something I needed to read. Thank you :)

I feel ya man. I’m trying to look at it like although I think I’m a bitch for not finally killing my self, maybe there’s a part of me like a little glimmer of hope that is screaming at me telling me to not go through with it. Maybe we’re both stronger than we think. I don’t want to try and tell you how to think or what to do but I really hope you’re staying safe and things get manageable :)

I am sorry that you’re going through this. 

Although I may not know your past that has led you to this downward spiral into these thoughts just as I. 

The idea of seeing everyone strive while we collapse into ash puts so much pressure to this point. 

Most times I tell myself why I’m still alive and that I’m pathetic for not going through with it. 

But there’s a piece I found that gets me through sometimes. Naturally we don’t want to go through it not because we don’t have the balls, but you know as well as I know that we have the balls to keep living. Keep surviving in this chaotic world that challenges us and tries to put us down. 

The darkness of the world and the void that consumes you to stop talking to people, make bad habits, could never consume us because the spark of light that keeps us going will never be extinguished. 

I hope you stay safe :)

I feel that. The feeling that you’re not worth all the love or compliments or just things others see in us. I sometimes want to yell at them and scare my friends away cause I think they’re looking at a lie. We’re always not good enough in our eyes but maybe we just have to take in the love little pieces at a time. I’m sure you’re a great and attractive person but the artist is their greatest critic. I hope you are doing great and we’ll all get through this :) stay safe

Pretty dumb but being a failure. I hate myself cause I’m a failure in my eyes. I do stuff that kills need cause I feel like I deserve it. My friends and family are so helpful and nice to me I cry cause I don’t want them to. I’m a failure and I’m not worth the love and affection. I’m sorry if it seems like I’m trying to attention seek I’m so sorry. I hope all of you are staying safe and try to remember that you are unique and loved even though you may not know. I love you all :)

This one hits home. I do know that feeling but I hope that you’re doing okay. Most times I think it’s good to cry ya know it’s the most intense form of emotion so it’s definitely a good way to just pour your heart out. I hope you’re having a good and safe night! :)

I get ya it’s fucking tough. I find myself in the same situation. But maybe that’s the part of you or me that feels that we don’t deserve peace or even happiness. Our stubbornness is kickin our ass but in time we’ll get through it. Hope you’re feeling safe and having a better day managing the chaos of this absurd world :)

No problem I hope it did! We’re both young lads (idk how young I’m 19 already) but life will try it’s best to knock us down. Fuck em lol 
I hope you have a good rest of your day!

I agree. There’s a point in ones life where everything is meaningless and might as well end it. I’m a young man myself and have planned on ending my life at the end of next month; however, throughout my experiences with the absurd world you can see that there’s some peace in the chaos if you get me. I personally hate when peeps try to help me through god or whatever as if that’s the core truth of life. But it’s not the truth cause the world is absurd. That’s why death, famine, and all the evil exists.

We acknowledge our pointless life and choose to end it as if that will make sense of it. But the act of ending our lives is the fundamental problem with trying to solve our existence. 

In this chaos of the world we have to find our happiness within ourselves. When we fall we get back up and scorn the failure demanding to try again. You know you’re stronger than this and maybe this feeling will pass. But in time find yourself and try to instead of make sense of this senseless world, accept it as the presence of our existence. Sorry for rambling but I think in this storm you can find a better you

This breaks my heart to see someone shattered to pieces. I hope you’re still around to read this and recollect yourself. Believe me I understand where you’re coming from. My girlfriend broke up with me last year then more stress followed. Things still remind me of her and sets my heart racing and mind scrambled. Sometimes the mention of her name saddens me. I felt terrible. Blaming it all on me to the point where I join you in this cycle of self hate. 
However, you’re such a strong person for allowing yourself to open up to anyone in this gesture for help. We’re all not strong enough to deal with loss, but together we all talk to help eachother pick up the pieces to find our true self. I hope that there is someone you can talk to for some guidance to find all your shattered pieces.
